description: A 2kg ball is thrown from ground level at 30 degrees above horizontal with initial speed 20m/s. Simulate the trajectory under gravity (g=9.81m/s^2), ignoring air resistance.
reference_code:
import numpy as np
from scipy.integrate import solve_ivp
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def simulate(t_eval, y0, params):
    g = params['g']
    def dynamics(t, y):
        vx, vy, x, y_pos = y
        return [0, -g, vx, vy]
    
    sol = solve_ivp(dynamics, [t_eval[0], t_eval[-1]], y0, 
                    t_eval=t_eval, method='Radau', atol=1e-12, rtol=1e-12)
    return sol.y.T

# Ground truth: R = 35.31m, H = 5.10m
